description:
Follow live chess and prepare your next game on Mac. ChessEver brings tournaments, engine analysis and a local chess library into one desktop workspace.

FOLLOW LIVE TOURNAMENTS
Browse live events, follow players and keep several boards open while you work. Review the moves, results and published standings without losing your place.

ANALYZE AND PREPARE
Explore positions with Stockfish, review variations and use the opening explorer to study the moves that matter. Move from following a live game straight into analysis.

YOUR CHESS LIBRARY
Open PGN files, organize saved games and analyses, and search your library with desktop keyboard shortcuts. Use a workspace built for a keyboard, mouse and a bigger screen.

ONE CHESSEVER ACCOUNT
Sign in to access your account and subscription across ChessEver. Some features require a ChessEver Premium subscription.

Terms of Use: https://chessever.com/terms-of-use
promotionalText: Live tournaments, Stockfish analysis and your chess library in one Mac workspace.
